name: Case updated with correct product
description: This verifier confirms that the previously created unresolved phone case for Thomas Bailey at Initech has been correctly updated with the missing product information. It validates that the case now references Docker Enterprise Variant 15, while still matching the original case attributes such as channel, state.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case c
JOIN contact ct
  ON ct.contact_id = c.contact_id
JOIN account a
  ON a.account_id = c.account_id
JOIN "user" u
  ON u.user_id = ct.portal_user_id
JOIN product p
  ON p.product_id = c.product_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Thomas'
  AND u.last_name  = 'Bailey'
  AND a.name       = 'Initech'
  AND p.name       = 'Docker Enterprise Variant 15'
  AND c.channel    = 'phone'
  AND c.state      = 'in_progress';

name: Knowledge Link Verification
description: The unresolved phone case for Thomas Bailey at Initech is now associated with product Docker Enterprise Variant 15, and the linked knowledge article for that product is attached as a resolution to that same case.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM case_knowledge ck
JOIN knowledge k
  ON k.knowledge_id = ck.knowledge_id
JOIN product p
  ON p.product_id = k.product_id
JOIN customer_case c
  ON c.case_id = ck.case_id
JOIN contact ct
  ON ct.contact_id = c.contact_id
JOIN account a
  ON a.account_id = ct.account_id
JOIN "user" u
  ON u.user_id = ct.portal_user_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Thomas'
  AND u.last_name  = 'Bailey'
  AND a.name       = 'Initech'
  AND c.channel    = 'phone'
  AND c.state      = 'in_progress'
  AND c.product_id = p.product_id
  AND p.name       = 'Docker Enterprise Variant 15'
  AND ck.used_as   = 'applied'
  AND k.title LIKE '%Docker Enterprise Variant 15%';
